playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_1: Admiral J. C. Ibanez requests your assistance with a confidential GalCop investigation. Report to the GalCop liaison at Vegedius main orbital station for a full briefing.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_INFO: Report to Admiral Ibanez at Vegedius main orbital station, Galaxy 8.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_2a: Ibanez explains that Maenes is neutral under a GalCop treaty because QuiCo's Quitolline makes hyperspace travel tolerable. A member government's attack would violate that treaty. GalCop must protect the system and its orbital facilities.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_2b: An embedded source, LEXICON, reports suspicious Sirius Corporation interest in Maenes. Sirius is a private corporation rather than a treaty-bound government. Ibanez needs evidence before deciding whether this is an imminent threat.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_2c: Meet LEXICON through the secure communications service at Raaed main orbital station. He can make contact during a corporate transit stop, away from Sirius surveillance in Tevebebi. Protect his cover and bring his information back to Vegedius.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_INFO: Contact LEXICON through Raaed main orbital station's secure liaison service; return to Vegedius with the report.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_PF_INFO: Contact LEXICON through Raaed main orbital station's secure liaison service; return to Vegedius with the report.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_1a: At the docked secure terminal, LEXICON verifies your credentials. He works in Sirius procurement and has seen unexplained purchases of security equipment, tankers and support vessels despite no announced expansion. Recent invoices conceal the equipment descriptions even from procurement staff.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_1b:
REDACTED PROCUREMENT RECORD
Ship to: Sirius Corporation, Tevebebi, Galaxy 8
Order date: {invoice_day}
Order ID: SC4466632-54; reference IR_DR56_44/1
Description and supplier: redacted
Quantity: 20; unit price: 37,500 credits
Goods subtotal: 750,000 credits; shipping: 2,400 credits; total: 752,400 credits
Recorded unit mass: 20 tonnes; dimensions: 30 x 8 x 25 (unit of length not recorded).
The commercial record is evidence, not cargo you own. The figures are clues for Jane's records search.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_1c: LEXICON also found a strategic-planning analyst's claim for accommodation at Maenes orbital station. Sirius personnel rarely make such visits, and Maenes is protected from corporate appropriation. LEXICON suspects a concealed reconnaissance visit; the expense claim survived the attempted concealment. That is a lead, not yet proof of an attack.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_1d: LEXICON describes Sirius' antimatter fuel business and its history of exploiting opposing fleets' demand for fuel. Its formidable SDF could enforce a commercial takeover. He warns that these unexplained purchases deserve investigation rather than dismissal as coincidence.
playable_text_overrides.IR_RAAED_1e: Save LEXICON's procurement and expenses evidence. He ends the secure call and returns to his scheduled transit duties. Report to Ibanez at Vegedius main orbital station without exposing the source.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_3: Ibanez receives the unexplained-purchases and concealed-visit report. Take the redacted procurement record to Jane's Shipyard Intelligence at Biraa main orbital station. Ask Janne Lindberg, a reserve GalCop intelligence captain, to identify the craft using the remaining commercial data.
playable_text_overrides.IR_JANES_INFO: Contact Janne Lindberg through Jane's at Biraa main orbital station, Galaxy 8.
playable_text_overrides.IR_JANES_1a: Lindberg examines the redacted record through the station liaison. The price, mass and dimensions remain visible. He searches Jane's shipbuilding records for matching commercial equipment.
playable_text_overrides.IR_JANES_1b: The record matches a Zarxe International order for civilian orbital station-support craft, distributed by Yokohama Exports in Aletius. They are ordinary commercial vessels, but their equipment could support a hostile seizure of orbital facilities. Their purchase alone does not establish a crime.
playable_text_overrides.IR_JANES_1c: Lindberg confirms that such civilian craft are openly traded; restricted weapons or evidence of a hostile plan would be more significant. Save his identification and return to Ibanez at Vegedius main orbital station.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_4a: Ibanez reviews the identified order. A large SDF fleet is familiar, but acquiring support craft suitable for securing orbital facilities could change Sirius' ability to seize QuiCo's infrastructure. GalCop still needs stronger evidence before approaching the Security Council.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_4b: If these craft complete Sirius' preparations, GalCop may have little time once the order is delivered. A monopoly over both Quitolline and military fuel would give Sirius immense influence. The divided Cooperation cannot rely on a quick collective response.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_4c: Pursue four investigations in any workable order: stop the twenty-craft shipment; find a way to undermine Sirius' financial position; investigate SDF leadership and opportunities to disrupt it; and examine Maenes' orbital defence network and its vulnerabilities. Keep a low profile so Sirius is not prompted to accelerate its plans.
playable_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_4d: Ibanez transfers the restricted dossier to your mission journal. Its directory lists the relevant organisations and station contacts. Ask questions through their main orbital station liaison services; revisit contacts as new leads appear. Report to Ibanez when all four investigations have outcomes. Confirm to begin the investigations and unlock the dossier.
playable_text_overrides.IR_finance_brief_0: Find a way to destabilise Sirius' finances.
playable_text_overrides.IR_shipment_brief_0: Stop Sirius from receiving the twenty-craft orbital support order.
playable_text_overrides.IR_SDF_brief_0: Investigate and disrupt the Sirius Defence Force's activities.
playable_text_overrides.IR_MAENES_intro: Open a secure docked liaison with QuiCo Pharmaceuticals. You identify yourself as a GalCop investigator and are connected to Colonel Carla Ruiz, head of orbital infrastructure security. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_YOKOHAMA_intro: Contact Yokohama Exports through Aletius main orbital station's commercial service. You pose as a prospective buyer. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_JANES_intro: Contact Janne Lindberg through Jane's liaison at Biraa main orbital station. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_PIRATE_intro: Contact Alsto Abonlo through Edzaar main orbital station's discreet mercenary liaison. Present your pilot credentials as a mercenary with a proposal. His staff verify the credentials and open the secure call. Confirm this introduction before discussing a contract.
playable_text_overrides.IR_PIRATE_intro_alt: Resume the secure liaison with pirate captain Alsto Abonlo at Edzaar main orbital station. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_PW_intro: Contact PleasureWorld's orbital arrivals and security liaison at Laxesori main station. Its staff offer to assist your investigation. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_NWE_intro: Contact Commander Stuart Nash through the Naval Weapons Establishment's liaison at Arance main orbital station. Present Ibanez's authorisation. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_GSE_intro: Contact Tobias King through the Galactic Stock Exchange liaison at Ustiza main orbital station. The senior analyst offers time for your questions. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.IR_KORSHKOV_intro: Contact OKB Korshkov through Aarzari main orbital station's engineering liaison. Choose an available line of inquiry.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-frontpage-text: GalCop High Command: Department of Information and Analysis. Powers and organisations of the Xrata galaxy. Authorised by Admiral J. C. Ibanez. This dossier supports the Sirius investigation. Its claims are briefing intelligence, not completed objectives. Research credits: Ramirez and phkb; the original brief credits J. Kell, R. Manzie, D. Bech, D. Massey and D. Braben. The playable station adaptation is separately labelled.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercialorgs-text: The directory covers OKB Korshkov, Galactic Stock Exchange, QuiCo Pharmaceuticals, Naval Weapons Establishment, Yokohama Exports, PleasureWorld, Jane's Shipyard Intelligence and Sirius Corporation. Locations below are Galaxy 8 systems. Contacts are accessed through orbital station services.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial1-text: Aarzari (10, 48), system 31. No named contact is supplied in the initial brief. This formerly Communist-affiliated independent design bureau specialises in propulsion, including the Strelka's magnetohydrodynamic drive and military hyperspace technology. Its engineering liaison operates through the main orbital station.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial2-text: Ustiza (133, 201), system 219. Contact: Tobias King, senior financial analyst. The GSE handles capital markets, securities trading and financial information. King's standing and influence may help GalCop obtain relevant analysis and services through the main orbital station liaison.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial3-text: Maenes (108, 91), system 23. No named contact is supplied in the initial brief. QuiCo is the sole producer of Quitolline, the treatment that made widespread hyperspace travel practical. The Treaty of Maenes protects its neutrality and facilities. An attack by a treaty member would be treated as an act of war. Use main orbital station security liaison for inquiries.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial4-text: Arance (223, 145), system 180. Contact: Commander Stuart Nash, Systems Development Division. The NWE develops naval weapons and equipment and works with outside specialists. Competitive tenders have reduced its monopoly over naval contracts. Its liaison is available through the main orbital station.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial5-text: Aletius (39, 234), system 171. No named contact is supplied in the initial brief. Yokohama sells and distributes commercial ships, including tankers, transports and shuttles, through a wide sales and courier network. Approach its main orbital station commercial liaison as a prospective buyer.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial6-text: Laxesori (111, 60), system 119. No named contact is supplied in the initial brief. PleasureWorld's orbital visitor and passenger services handle substantial traffic. Its crowded orbital port attracts illicit trade and covert meetings, while its security staff cooperate with GalCop. Requests for arrivals and security records use the main station liaison.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial7-text: Biraa (117, 248), system 232. Contact: Janne Lindberg, industry analyst and reserve GalCop intelligence captain. Jane's collects information on ship design, construction and deployment. Lindberg can compare incomplete procurement details with its extensive records through the main orbital station liaison.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-commercial8-text: Tevebebi (191, 218), system 145, Xrata outpost. No friendly contact is supplied. Sirius' advanced antimatter fuel technology and its history of supplying opposing war fleets made it powerful. Reports suggest that it remains ruthless in protecting its commercial position. This is background intelligence; do not contact Sirius directly on GalCop's behalf.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-noncommercialorgs-text: The following entries describe the League of Anarchists, Sirius Defence Force and KSR. They are intelligence subjects and possible leads, not three additional missions.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-noncommercial1-text: Edzaar (172, 63), system 240, is the suspected operating area. No named contact is supplied in the initial brief. LoA's nominally anarchist factions include pirate groups believed responsible for attacks on commercial convoys. GalCop has not yet intervened. Reading this entry does not establish contact or hire their help.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-noncommercial2-text: Tevebebi (191, 218), system 145. No friendly contact is supplied. The SDF is Sirius' heavily funded security and paramilitary arm, protecting fleets and enforcing corporate security. Its counter-intelligence personnel monitor employees suspected of disloyalty. The source records its motto as Astrum Defende.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-noncommercial3-text: Location unspecified; no named contact supplied. The Communist systems' external intelligence service maintains undercover diplomatic residencies at major orbital stations. It has shifted resources from long-term covert agents towards signals collection and monitoring stations. No system marker or new operation is inferred from this description.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-appendix-text: Read the four objectives, contact procedure and journal guidance. This adaptation keeps all playable actions in space or docked orbital station services.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-objectives-text: Prevent Sirius from receiving the twenty-craft orbital station-support order. Find a way to destabilise its finances. Investigate and disrupt SDF leadership and operations. Examine Maenes' orbital defences and possible countermeasures. Keep separate outcome receipts for all four; the later debrief depends on their actual results.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-procedure-text: Visit the named organisations through their main orbital station services. Conceal your GalCop affiliation where the contact dialogue requires a commercial or mercenary cover. Do not approach Sirius directly. Follow new leads and return to Ibanez at Vegedius after all four investigation outcomes. Reading the dossier, map or log never supplies evidence or completes an objective.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-hints-text: Investigations can progress in parallel. Questions change as leads are confirmed, so revisit contacts and consult the journal's directory and current objectives. The mission conversation log lets you reread confirmed dialogue; the mission communications log preserves received flight messages. Both remain read-only. Viewing either does not replay a choice, make a contact, move a deadline or award a reward.
playable_text_overrides.iron_raven-brief: Iron Raven: restricted orbital intelligence dossier
